annotations.title: Get Kick channels, streams, and clips

description: Read public Kick.com data. For each channel name or link: followers, verified mark, bio, social links, recent categories, and live status, with optional past broadcasts and clips. Also searches channels by word and reads the live directory, most viewers first, filtered by category and language.

channels.description: Kick channel names (xqc or @xqc) or links (https://kick.com/xqc). Each channel returns one row with followers, verified mark, bio, social links, recent categories, and live status.

clips_period.description: Which clips: day, week, month, or all (default).

clips_sort.description: view (default): most viewed first. date: newest first, in Kick's order by clip ID, where clips made within the same minute can appear slightly out of time order.

include_clips.description: yes to add one row per clip of each channel. Default no.

include_videos.description: yes to add one row per past broadcast (VOD) of each channel, newest first. Default no.

live_category.description: Optional, with live_now. A Kick category as it appears in its kick.com link: a main category (games, irl, music, gambling, creative, alternative) or a subcategory such as just-chatting, slots, or valorant.

live_language.description: Optional, with live_now. Keep only streams in this language, such as English, Spanish, or en.

live_now.description: yes to return streams live now, most viewers first, one row per stream. Default no.

max_channels_per_search.description: How many channels to keep from each search word, in Kick's order. Default 5, maximum 20.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_clips_per_channel.description: Clips to return per channel. Kick sends 20 a page. Default 20, maximum 1000.

max_live_streams.description: Live streams to return, with live_now. Default 50, maximum 1000.

max_videos_per_channel.description: Past broadcasts to return per channel. Kick keeps a limited history, often the last 30 days. Default 20, maximum 500.

search.description: Optional. Words to search Kick channels with, such as poker or valorant. Each word returns its top channels, and each found channel gets a channel row.
